reviewer: independent integration_recon agent; did not author implementation
authority: Acceptance proposal only; parent review and active single integration owner decide canonical transition.
scope: Validate structured AI output using strict Pydantic models, JSON Schema and typed results; reject arbitrary free-form JSON before production consumption.

criteria.criterion: Use strict schema-validated Pydantic output and typed result objects.
criteria.assertions: Valid results have exact typed model identity; strict field types and enum/list/string bounds are enforced; undeclared top-level and nested fields fail.

criteria.criterion: Use declared JSON Schema through a capability-aware provider-neutral boundary.
criteria.assertions: Generated schema closes object definitions and reaches the real provider method; unsupported structured capabilities and disabled provider fail before generation. OpenAI wire mode is JSON object, followed by local schema validation; vendor-native schema enforcement is not claimed.

criteria.criterion: Do not trust arbitrary free-form JSON.
criteria.assertions: Malformed/non-text/root-array/root-scalar/trailing/fenced JSON, duplicate root/nested keys, nonstandard constants, oversized text, wrong types and extra fields are rejected with sanitized fixed errors.

criteria.criterion: Apply the contract in existing production consumers before publishing results.
criteria.assertions: All three production generation call sites use generate_structured. Six malformed raw response payloads through real OpenAI adapter and durable worker block with AI_ERROR, publish no history even after Store reopen, retain no raw response canary in public result/operation/audit and make no additional call on replay. Valid control completes and survives reopen. Resume raw-JSON failure and successful immutable-source readback pass.
